translation: Took place in posad Serock, 20 December 1890 at 4 PM. Appeared personally Lejba [unclear: Sztamger/Szmanger], trader, 65, and Berek Koltun, laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 8 PM died a child of male sex named Dawid Lejbka [unclear: Szejngolc], three weeks old, son of [unclear: Delusz/Dowusz] and his wife Chaja Dwojra nee Szperling. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of [Szejngolc] this act was read and signed by us; the witnesses are illiterate.
